text:
Mina Patel: CI red on hosted-integ (shard-7). Failing group: auth + streaming + toolcall. Not a single unit test, whole shard failed. Anyone seen this pattern?
CI Bot: Job <https://ci.redwood.local/job/hosted-integ/1234|hosted-integ #1234> failed — tests: `TestAuthHeader`, `TestStreamChunking`, `TestToolCallRetries`. Logs attached.
Mina Patel: quick log excerpt: ```
ERROR AuthMiddleware: missing signature header
stream: connection closed while decoding frame
toolcall: POST /tool/run -> 504 gateway timeout
```
Samir Kaur: grabbing it. Looks like three different symptoms but all hit the hosted API. I'll bisect the last several infra rolls & config commits. Can someone queue a rerun for shard-7 in the meantime?
devops-runner: `/ci rerun job=hosted-integ shard=7` queued as run #1235 — started.
Olivia Chen: fyi we rolled auth-schema v2 -> v3 yesterday in staging; auth header changed from `X-Redwood-Auth` -> `Authorization: Bearer` in the proxy mapping. Could be a header-mapping regression for hosted.
Jordan Lee: also saw an increase in upstream timeouts around 22:10 UTC. Toolcall clients are retrying aggressively — might amplify flakiness.
Samir Kaur: good catch @Olivia. I'll check the proxy mapping commit (deploy/proxy-config 2026-03-16). If mapping missing, auth tests would 401 and streaming handshake could fail.
Mina Patel: rerun #1235 is running — test runner shows `TestAuthHeader` failing first.
Samir Kaur: starting a git bisect across infra-config: `/infra/scripts/bisect-deploy --service hosted-proxy --since 2026-03-01 --until HEAD --test TestAuthHeader`
CI Bot: Bisect job created: <https://ci.redwood.local/job/bisect/77|bisect/77>. Next: pick a candidate deploy for repro.
Olivia Chen: quick workaround: can we pin the proxy to previous mapping for dedicated e2e by setting `PROXY_AUTH_MODE=legacy` in the job env? If that fixes auth we can be confident it's mapping.
Samir Kaur: good idea. Kicking a pinned run: `/ci rerun job=hosted-integ shard=7 env.PROXY_AUTH_MODE=legacy` queued (#1236).
Jordan Lee: note: streaming failure logs show `invalid preface` not EOF; might be TLS mismatch on the upgrade handshake if a proxy route changed. Keep an eye.
Mina Patel: holding merging on the feature branch that touched toolcall retries until we confirm. Can we add a smoke check that verifies auth header passthrough in the PR?
Samir Kaur: yes, adding quick smoke: `curl -v -H "X-Redwood-Auth: test"` and assert header arrives at backend. Will add to the CI stage.
CI Bot: Run #1236 finished — `TestAuthHeader` passed, `TestStreamChunking` still flaky (1/3 failures), `TestToolCallRetries` timed out again.
Mina Patel: looks like mapping rollback helped auth. Stream + toolcall remain. Samir, do you want me to open a short-lived incident channel for coordinated triage?
Samir Kaur: let's keep it here for now. I'm going to dig into the streaming logs in bisect job and compare kernel images between runs. If we don't get a clear root in 30m we can escalate to eng-runtime.
Olivia Chen: ping me if you need the proxy logs — I can attach pcap and proxy config from the rollout.
Jordan Lee: also check client-side backoff — we might be exposing a subtle race where auth succeeds but the KV cache isn't primed, causing stream handshake failures under load.
Mina Patel: thanks everyone — will mark branch as blocked until bisect completes. Please @mention if you find a quick revert candidate. :thumbsup:
